decision.explanation: Retain the functionally proved r326 integer-bit variant as local work in progress. Two integrated sessions show about 9–10% less time on the 24-DOF chain and 2.5–6% on free+ball, with central gains around 1–3% on branches and some uncertain intervals. Spatial-tendon movement is about 2% slower with repeatable intervals above 1; fixed-tendon medians are 1.2–6.2% higher with wider, mixed intervals. These remain explicit regressions to resolve. All C 3.17/C 3.14 validation/release mass, derivative and boundary gates pass on the exact variant. Final C parity is pending: the wheel compiler flags are unknown and movement still trails C materially. No runtime checks or warnings were suppressed, and no public input restriction was added. The slice-view experiment is not retained: it added no SIMD, lost the chain gain and still has two open invariants.
decision.next_step: Use the separate compiler vectorization report to identify the loop control/index/alias blocker before implementing a fixed-size block or other C-aligned row representation; resolve tendon regressions with repeated integrated measurements. Keep the complete port/3.17 alignment and final C performance acceptance goal open.
